# Augment Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Augment configuration. The main output is `.augment/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - augment
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - augment:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property          | Value                             |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 2                            |
| **Main output**   | `.augment/rules/project.md`       |
| **Dot directory** | `.augment/`                       |
| **Skills**        | No                                |
| **Agents**        | Yes (`.augment/agents/<name>.md`) |
| **Commands**      | No                                |
| **Local files**   | No                                |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                        | Purpose              |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.augment/rules/project.md` | Primary rule file    |
| Agents            | `.augment/agents/<name>.md` | Agent configurations |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .augment/rules/project.md file                 |
| `multifile`      | Single .augment/rules/project.md file                 |
| `full` (default) | .augment/rules/project.md + .augment/agents/<name>.md |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
